messages:
tess: opened a PR to update the model catalog entry for Polaris13b-family. Need to add limits, compatibility notes, and a short migration checklist for folks moving to the quantized variants. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5017
vikram: small ask - call out the sequence ceiling for the quantized variant (we're seeing 4096 stable, beyond that KV cache falls back). Otherwise customers hit truncation silently.
sam: can we include a tiny benchmark row for latency (p50) and throughput on g4dn vs p4d for both fp16 and quant? I'll paste numbers. Also flag runtime 3.0 as "partial" support for polaris-quant-v1.
tess: yes. I'll add a note: "polaris-quant-v1: runtime 3.0 partial (attention kernel missing); runtime 3.2+ full". Adding a short migration checklist and the benchmark table.
vikram: found a stale link to docs/quant-old.md in the polaris card. Replace with docs/quant/guide.md and add a redirect.
tess: noted, will update link + add redirect PR. Assigning: sam - bench CSV + numbers; vikram - redirect PR + confirm sequence ceiling; I'll push edits by EOD.
sam: uploading CSV in 20m.
docs-bot: PR #5017 opened by tess: docs/model-catalog: polaris family card updates + migration checklist (labels: docs, model-catalog)
tess: thanks all. Once I have numbers and the redirect I'll request reviews. aiming to merge after CI and one approval.
vikram: quick wording note: say "will fall back" when describing automated fallback to compatible variants. Avoid hedged language.
tess: updated. ping me for any nitpicks.
